verdict.rationale: The documented Gmail API lets your own agent read mail (read-only extraction), triage it (filters, labels, push notifications on mailbox changes) and send it (users.messages.send with RFC 2822 MIME), all under granular OAuth scopes. However, you must build the integration yourself, including OAuth and base64url MIME encoding. The evidence shows no ready-made connector for agents like Claude or ChatGPT, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an agent-ready connector (e.g., MCP or an official Claude/ChatGPT integration), evidence of API-level draft creation, machine-readable API specs, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full workflow.
